title: Reaching engineers who have the old discovery plugin next to paqad
context: Engineers who already installed the old discovery plugin (3.2.0) next to paqad can lose their stage checks after the next update, because the update renames it to paqad. Doctor and update catch it only when someone runs them. How should we reach these people? This decides whether the rename ships in this release and how much outreach happens first.
